title: Prevent Procedural Input Rewire on Drag
description: procedural: codemo components tend to rewire existing inputs to outputs, for example a Brep with an input suddenly reconnects the edge to the output.
summary: Fixed procedural/codemo BRep wire jumps for same-named input and output ports. DAG handle lookup now keys internal handles by direction while preserving public fixture endpoints, so hexagonal mushroom column keeps e112 on the BRep input and e113 on the BRep output. Flow insert-between also avoids rewiring through nodes that already have incoming inputs. Verified with focused DAG and flow regressions, the full flow core lib suite, WASM build, and browser loading of the hexagonal fixture.
